image_prompt: Describe this image and let's talk about what it shows.
unreadable: I could not read {count} image(s): the download failed or the address did not serve an image. I did not use that content as evidence.
too_large: I left {count} image(s) unread because each exceeds the {limit} MiB limit.
vision_disabled: The vision service is unavailable right now, so I did not read {count} image(s).
failed: I could not read {count} image(s) with the vision model. I did not use that content as evidence.
omitted: I left {count} more image(s) unread; I can read up to {limit} per message.
recovery: Resend the image or describe what it shows and we can talk about it.
